newsitem.title: LEBANON: Beirut weekly T-bill issue raises 604 bln pounds.
newsitem.headline: Beirut weekly T-bill issue raises 604 bln pounds.

text.p: Lebanon's weekly treasury bill issue of October 24 raised 604 billion Lebanese pounds, the finance ministry said on Monday. The previous issue raised 702 billion pounds.
The results were issued more than two hours late due to technical reasons, but a previously announced delay to Tuesday was avoided.

The Lebanese pound closed at 1,556.5 to the U.S. dollar on Monday from 1,557 a week earlier and 1,605.5 a year ago.
